Definition: Kehelathah, a place in the Desert
BiblicalUsage: Kehelathah is a camp in the wilderness journey: they journeyed from Rissah, and pitched in Kehelathah. They journeyed from Kehelathah, and pitched in mount Shapher.
TheologicalSignificance: I read the camp as one night on the long road, named because God counted every stopping place.
